 Published Oct. 23, 2026 12:24 p.m. ET share facebook x reddit link Week 7 may have been the wildest college football week in years as five top-7 teams went down. So what will Week 8 bring for an encore? 
 We start with a "Big Noon Kickoff" showdown between No. 6 Indiana and Michigan in Ann Arbor. Can new starting quarterback Tommy Carr salvage the Wolverines’ season and pull off the upset, or will the Hoosiers bounce back after their first loss in nearly two years?
 In the SEC, Auburn is coming off its biggest win of the last decade after stunning No. 1 Georgia. Can the Tigers keep the momentum going, or will Lane Kiffin come to town and spoil the party?
 Meanwhile, No. 2 BYU is riding high after its massive win over No. 4 Notre Dame last week. But can the Cougars avoid a trap game on the road against UCF and keep their undefeated season alive?
 Elsewhere, No. 19 Texas looks to avoid its third straight loss as Trinidad Chambliss and No. 7 Ole Miss come to Austin for a huge SEC showdown. And in the Big Ten, will Lincoln Riley and No. 16 USC go into a hostile environment in Madison and take down Wisconsin, or will the Trojans get caught looking ahead to next week’s matchup against Ohio State?
Here are our expert picks for another loaded Week 8 college football slate.
